caution_findings.finding: DRAMP exact percent killing values are graph-derived from Figure 5D and use a label not used by the source paper.
Figure 2C shows P2shortA as N-terminally acetylated, while DRAMP raw metadata says N-terminal free.
The XML/NXML has zero table-wraps; the prior Table 1/2/3 request was stale for this article and was replaced by figure/body/supplement review.
Local supplementary assets were checked; gate-changing values are in the supplementary PDF text and primary figures, while landing HTML/bin files do not provide structured assay tables.
Final mechanism does not claim antimicrobial, membrane, nucleic-acid, or protein-synthesis mechanism for this paper.
